name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: This was done thrice, and the vessel was received up again into heaven. While Peter doubted in himself what the vision meant, the men sent from Cornelius had already found Simon's house and stood before the gate, asking whether Simon called Peter lodged there.

note.label: Acts 10: Cornelius and the Northern Kingdom Grafted In
